name: Merge Blocks
description: Drop number blocks into the columns: two matching blocks merge into one. Chain merges to multiply your score!

descriptions.vi: Thả khối số vào cột, hai khối giống nhau sẽ gộp lại. Gộp liên tiếp để nhân điểm!
descriptions.en: Drop number blocks into the columns: two matching blocks merge into one. Chain merges to multiply your score!
